text: Thanks. The engine's current source list (status.json) doesn't show sxbet yet: it needs (1) the app on v0.116.0 with Settings > SX Bet switched ON (that setting mirrors to the engine), and (2) an engine restart so it reads the new secret (a key send restarts it by itself; otherwise the next 6h handover does). Check Settings > APIs > SX Bet > Test says 'Active and accepted'. Tell me what the Test says and I'll read the engine's first SX answers.
